news_items.title: Judge to Altman and Musk: Keep a lid on it
news_items.summary: A federal judge warned Elon Musk and Sam Altman to stop using social media to escalate their legal battle, telling them to maintain a 'clean slate' during the OpenAI lawsuit proceedings.

news_items.title: NXP shares jump 13% on auto, industrial chip resurgence

news_items.title: Poolside debuts its first open-weight AI model

news_items.title: SpaceX acquires Cursor in $60 billion AI coding deal
